bio: Jorge is a freelance developer who builds websites, web apps, and custom tooling for design studios, startups, and agencies.
Since 2019, Jorge has worked with Cynda Media Lab, a transdisciplinary design studio, building and maintaining sites and educational tools for clients like MIT, FIT, and AFFOA.
Jorge has also worked with Fabric Ventures, migrating and building pages in Webflow and shipping an AI-powered search agent for their site, deployed on Vercel.
skills: Shopify (custom themes, Liquid sections and schemas)
Craft CMS (Twig templating and content modeling)
Building and deploying AI-powered features (e.g. RAG search agents)
